blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)在学习期间可以改进任务性能,但这些成绩并不一定反映学习者此后独立应用知识和技能的能力. 我们介绍AI Cosmos是定位学习的代理基础设施,它围绕两个互补原则组织学习:基于情景的参与和累积的实践资产。 AI Cosmos在学习情景中组织学习者和角色专门人员,这些情景融合了与任务相关的知识,并在需要时结合了可执行的工作本位. 资产-模拟循环保留了作为可重复使用的资产的流程和结果,具有明确的出处和依赖性。 我们通过两项预先登记的随机控制研究来评价基于情景的相互作用,这些研究审查法律推理和编程能力的获得情况,在各种条件下维持同样的LLM。 AI Cosmos在法律推理方面比常规LLM获得更大的学习收益,并且比LLM-as-Teacher基线更能掌握看不见的编程问题.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In 1929, philosopher Alfred North Whitehead described the problem of inert knowledge in his seminal collection “The Aims of Education”: “…the problem of keeping knowledge alive, of preventing it from becoming inert, which is the central problem of all education” ( Whitehead, 1929 ) .
Nearly a century later, Whitehead’s diagnosis remains relevant, despite successive advances in educational technologies.
Today, generative AI appears to offer a promising remedy to this enduring problem by providing intelligence that is continuously accessible, highly interactive, and readily adaptable into explanations and personalized tutorials ( Ruiz-Rojas et al., 2023 ; Baidoo-Anu and Ansah, 2023 ; Ooi et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
1929年,哲学家Alfred North Whitehead在他的开创性著作"教育的目的"中描述了惰性知识的问题:"......保持知识的生命力,防止知识成为惰性,这是所有教育的中心问题"(Whitehead, 1929).
近一个世纪后,尽管教育技术不断进步,但Whitehead的诊断仍然有意义。
今天,遗传性人工智能似乎为这一持久问题提供了一种有希望的补救办法,即提供持续可得、高度互动和易于适应的解释和个人化辅导的知识(Ruiz-Rojas等人,2023年;Baidoo-Anu和Ansah,2023年;Ooi等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2024年)。

blocks.en:
Yet, this remedy may not close the gap between knowing and doing but instead widen it in a new form.
Across educational settings, learners become more fluent in reproducing AI-provided concepts, explanations, and solutions ( Handa et al., 2025 ) without commensurate gains in their ability to apply that knowledge independently ( Fan et al., 2024b ; Bastani et al., 2025b ) , a discrepancy we refer to as performance–competence decoupling ( Yan et al., 2025 ) .
For instance, an undergraduate student may be able to explain the divide-and-conquer tactic of quicksort yet struggle to implement it robustly ( Lehmann et al., 2025 ) ; similarly, a bar-exam candidate can fluently state a legal doctrine yet fails to apply it to an unfamiliar case ( Kowalski, 2010 ) .
These examples reflect a structural asymmetry: generative AI has substantially reduced the cost of accessing and reproducing declarative knowledge (“knowing what”) ( Usdan et al., 2024 ) , without producing an equivalent improvement in procedural knowledge (“knowing how”) ( Lee et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,这种补救办法可能无法弥合了解与做之间的差距,而是以新的形式扩大差距。
在整个教育环境中,学习者在复制人工智能提供的概念、解释和解决方案方面变得更加流利(Handa等人,2025年),而没有相应提高独立应用这种知识的能力(Fan等人,2024年b;Bastani等人,2025年b),我们称之为性能-能力脱钩(Yan等人,2025年))。
例如,本科生也许能够解释速战速决的分裂和征服策略,但为了有力地实施这一策略而挣扎(Lehmann等人,2025年);同样,巴席姆候选人可以流利地阐述一种法律学说,但却未能将其应用于不熟悉的案件(Kowalski,2010年)。
这些例子反映了结构上的不对称:基因识别法大大降低了获取和再生宣告性知识(“知道什么”)的成本(Usdan等人,2024年),但没有对程序知识产生相应的改进(“知道如何”)。 (Lee等人,2025年).

blocks.en:
We should note that this asymmetry no longer stems from LLM capability, but from the interaction scheme in which these models are used ( Ding and Chan, 2023 ; Shi et al., 2024 ) .
Despite the diversity of AI-assisted educational applications, from content creation to lesson planning ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2024a ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) , a common interaction pattern is the request–artifact exchange , where the learner submits a request, the system produces an explanation or artifact, and the interaction often ends once that artifact is delivered ( Chao et al., 2026 ) .
Question answering is such an epistemic outsourcing example, more accurate and pedagogically appropriate responses may improve immediate task performance without requiring learners to reason through, test, or revise solutions themselves.
The limitation, therefore, is not simply the quality of generated outputs, but whether the interaction supports the activities through which competence develops.
Learning research emphasizes active participation, feedback, and iterative revision within meaningful, scaffolded activities ( Chi and Wylie, 2014 ; Lave and Wenger, 1991 ; Collins and Kapur, 2006 ; Hmelo-Silver et al., 2007 ) .
When assistance is organized primarily around output delivery, learners’ actions, feedback, and revisions may remain outside the interaction, limiting opportunities to support continued practice and use its outcomes to inform subsequent learning ( Laurillard, 2013 ; Beale, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们应当指出,这种不对称不再源于LLM能力,而源于使用这些模型的相互作用计划(Ding and Chan, 2023; Shi等人, 2024)。
尽管AI协助的教育应用多种多样,从内容创造到课程规划(Yu等人,2024年;Fan等人,2024年a; Zheng等人,2025年),一个常见的交互模式是请求-艺术交流,其中学习者提交请求,系统生成解释或文物,一旦交付文物,交互经常结束(Chao等人,2026年).
回答问题就是这种概论性外包的例子,更准确和在教学上适当的反应可能改善即时任务业绩,而不需要学习者自己通过推理、测试或修改解决办法。
因此,限制不仅仅是产出的质量,而是互动是否支持发展能力的活动。
学习研究强调在有意义的脚手架活动范围内的积极参与、反馈和迭代修订 (Chi and Wylie,2014年;Lave and Wenger,1991年;Collins and Kapur,2006年;Hmelo-Silver等人,2007年).
当援助主要围绕产出交付来组织时,学习者的行动、反馈和修订可能仍然处于互动之外,限制了支持持续实践的机会,并利用其成果为后续学习提供信息(Laurillard,2013年;Beale,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Recent LLM-based tutoring systems structure pedagogical dialogue and feedback to support learners’ reasoning ( Chowdhury et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , while general-purpose multi-agent frameworks coordinate role-specialized agents to complete complex tasks ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Hong et al., 2024 ; Qian et al., 2024 ) .
Yet the effectiveness of these systems in supporting learners’ sustained competence development cannot be inferred from the quality of instructional guidance or the success of agent task execution alone.
One consideration is agency-preserving participation , which emphasizes learners’ active engagement in explaining, testing, and revising their own work within authentic or scaffolded activities, rather than merely receiving generated solutions ( Lave and Wenger, 1991 ; Chi and Wylie, 2014 ) .
Tool-using agents are often designed for autonomous task execution ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024a ) ; when applied to educational settings, such designs may position learners primarily as requesters or evaluators of completed work.
A second consideration is maintaining cumulative, inspectable record of practice . Constructionism emphasizes the educational value of artifacts that learners can create, examine, and improve over time ( Papert and Harel, 1991 ) .
Agentic systems also accumulate and refine reusable skills from past experience ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , although their reported gains primarily concern subsequent agent task performance rather than learners’ use of prior practice.
Taken together, these considerations motivate an approach to AI-assisted learning that centers learners’ own reasoning and action within learning activities, while enabling subsequent activities to build on prior practice.
blocks.zh:
最近基于LLM的辅导系统构建了教学对话和反馈,以支持学习者的推理(Chowdhury等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年),而通用的多剂框架则协调角色专业代理,以完成复杂的任务(Wu等人,2023年;Hong等人,2024年;Qian等人,2024年).
然而,仅凭教学指导的质量或代理任务执行的成功,无法推断这些系统在支持学生持续培养能力方面的有效性。
一个考虑是机构保护参与,强调学生在真实或脚手架活动中积极参与解释、测试和修订自己的工作,而不是仅仅接受产生的解决方案(Lave and Wenger,1991年;Chi and Wylie,2014年)。
工具使用剂往往被设计为自主任务执行(姚等人,2023年;杨等人,2024a年);当应用于教育环境时,这种设计可以将学习者主要定位为要求者或已完成工作的评估者.
第二个考虑是保持累积的、可检查的实践记录。 建筑主义强调学习者可以随着时间的推移而创造、检查和改进的文物的教育价值(Plat和Harel,1991年)。
代理系统还积累和完善从过去的经验(Zhang等人,2026年b)中可重复使用的技能,尽管它们所报告的收益主要涉及后续代理任务的业绩,而不是学习者对以往做法的利用。
综合起来,这些考虑促使采用人工智能辅助学习的方法,将学习者自己的推理和行动放在学习活动中,同时使随后的活动能够借鉴以往的做法。

blocks.en:
We translate these considerations into two complementary architectural shifts.
The first shift moves from request-artifact exchange to scenario-based participation , which organizes learning around learners’ active involvement in socially mediated, tool-supported activities ( Lave and Wenger, 1991 ; Kaptelinin and Nardi, 1997 ) .
Each scenario integrates three configurable dimensions of practice: social (learners and role-specialized agents as co-participants), epistemic (task-relevant knowledge resources), and operational (stateful, executable workbenches, i.g., a coding IDE,, when needed).
Learners and agents coordinate through dialogue and, when applicable, perform task-relevant operations on shared workbench states.
The resulting observations inform subsequent dialogue and actions, supporting learners in applying knowledge, evaluating outcomes, and adapting their approaches through practice.
The second shift moves from one-off artifacts to cumulative assets of practice .
Rather than treating final outputs as the endpoint of learning activities, this shift makes the processes and outcomes of practice available for reuse.
Subsequent scenarios can thus build on accumulated experience, supporting continuity across learning activities.
Together, these shifts place learners’ active participation and the accumulation of practical experience at the center of AI-assisted learning, shifting the emphasis from task completion to the development of learners’ competence ( Kolb, 2014 ; Schön, 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们把这些考虑转化为两个相辅相成的建筑转变。
第一个转变是从请求艺术交流转向以情景为基础的参与,它围绕学习者积极参与社会调解、工具支持的活动进行学习(Lave和Wenger,1991年;Kaptelinin和Nardi,1997年)。
每种情景都融合了三个可定性的实践层面:社会层面(作为共同参与者的学者和角色专门机构)、认识层面(与任务相关的知识资源)和可操作层面(具体、可执行的工作本,即必要时编码IDE)。
学习者和代理人通过对话进行协调,并在适用的情况下,在共享工作状态下开展与任务有关的业务。
由此产生的意见为后续对话和行动提供了信息,支持学习者应用知识、评价成果和通过实践调整方法。
第二步从一次性文物转向累积自业资产.
这种转变不是将最后产出视为学习活动的终点,而是使实践的过程和结果可供再利用。
因此,随后的情景可以借鉴积累的经验,支持各种学习活动的连续性。
这些转变共同将学习者的积极参与和积累实践经验置于AI辅助学习的中心,将重点从完成任务转向培养学习者的能力(Kolb,2014年;Schön,2017年)。

blocks.en:
We instantiate these shifts in AI Cosmos ( https://aicosmos.ai/ ), an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learner–agent participation in structured scenarios and preserves records of practice for reuse.
A scenario control plane configures each learning activity from a learner’s request by specifying its objective, participant roles, relevant knowledge resources, and executable workbenches when needed.
A task execution plane coordinates dialogue and workbench operations over shared task states, dynamically scheduling learners and agents to participate in iterative problem solving, execution, and revision.
To connect successive scenarios, an asset–memory loop extracts and validates reusable assets from scenario configurations and records of practice.
By retaining provenance and dependencies, these assets make prior outcomes and the associated reasoning, feedback, and revisions available for inspection and adaptation in subsequent activities.
We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, finding greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in the former and stronger programming mastery than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline in the latter.
blocks.zh:
我们在AI Cosmos(https://aicosmos.ai/)中将这些转变立即进行,这是一个用于定位学习的代理基础设施,它组织学习者-代理参与结构化情景,并保存再利用的实践记录。
情景控制平面根据学习者的要求,通过具体说明其目标、参与者角色、相关知识资源,以及必要时可执行的工作本位来配置每个学习活动。
任务执行平面在共享任务状态上协调对话框和工作本位操作,动态安排学习者和代理参与迭代问题解决,执行和修订.
为了连接连续的情景,一个资产-记忆循环从情景配置和实践记录中提取并验证可重复使用的资产.
通过保留来源和依赖性,这些资产使先前的结果和相关推理、反馈和修订可用于检查和适应以后的活动。
我们通过两项预先登记的随机控制研究来评价基于假设情景的相互作用,这些研究审查了法律推理和编程能力的获取,发现在前者中比常规的LLM有更大的学习收益,在后者中比LLM-as-Teacher基线更强的编程掌握能力.

blocks.en: Definition 2.2 (Asset). An asset is a typed, provenance-bearing unit of reusable outcome, [ a = ⟨ τ a , c a , s a , 𝒜 a prior ⟩ ] [a=\langle\tau_{a},c_{a},s_{a},\mathcal{A}_{a}^{\mathrm{prior}}\rangle] , where τ a \tau_{a} is its type, c a c_{a} is its content, s a s_{a} identifies its originating scenario, and 𝒜 a prior \mathcal{A}_{a}^{\mathrm{prior}} contains the prior assets on which it directly depends. We distinguish five asset types: • Role specification : a reusable definition of a participant role, including its responsibilities, behavioral instructions, and applicable task conditions; • Scenario specification : a complete or partial configuration ⟨ o , 𝒫 , 𝒦 , 𝒲 ⟩ \langle o,\mathcal{P},\mathcal{K},\mathcal{W}\rangle that can be instantiated or adapted in subsequent scenarios; • Knowledge artifact : a task-relevant object created or revised through a workbench, such as a slide deck, annotated document, or code module; • Process record : an inspectable sequence of participant actions, feedback, critiques, and revisions through which an outcome emerged; • Experience trace : structured evidence abstracted from execution, e.g., operation outcomes, failure cases, or observed relationships between configuration choices and task performance.

blocks.en:
By preserving content together with its provenance and dependencies, assets can be inspected, retrieved, adapted, and extended across scenarios.
In particular, scenario specifications, process records, and experience traces retain the conditions and actions surrounding an outcome, making records of prior practice available to future participants rather than preserving only the final product.

blocks.en: 3 System Architecture of AI Cosmos
blocks.zh: 3 AI宇宙系统架构

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Architecture of AI Cosmos. The scenario control plane configures learning environments, the task execution plane coordinates participant interactions and workbench operations, and the asset–memory substrate preserves and reuses validated assets across scenarios.
blocks.zh: 图2:AI宇宙建筑. 情景控制平面配置学习环境,任务执行平面协调参与者互动和工作台操作,资产-模拟底盘保存和再利用不同情景的验证资产.

blocks.en:
AI Cosmos implements the Scenario–Asset Framework via three interconnected components (Figure 2 ).
The scenario control plane configures learning objectives, participant roles, knowledge resources, and optional workbenches from learner requests and relevant prior assets.
The task execution plane coordinates learner–agent interactions and workbench operations via history-dependent scheduling.
Learners and agents operate on shared workbench states, with resulting observations informing subsequent interactions.
The asset–memory substrate derives reusable assets from scenario configurations and records of practice, manages their validation and admission, and preserves provenance and dependencies for reuse in subsequent scenarios.

学习者和代理人在共享工作区状态下运作,由此产生的观察为随后的互动提供了信息。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Human Study: Situated Learning for Bar-Examination Preparation
blocks.zh: 4.1 人文研究:在现场学习,为律师-调查做准备

blocks.en:
Legal problem solving provides a demanding test of application-oriented learning: success requires not only recalling legal doctrine but also identifying relevant rules and applying them to novel fact patterns.
We therefore use bar-examination preparation to test whether restructuring LLM interaction from conventional chat into a structured scenario improves learning of applied legal reasoning.
blocks.zh:
解决法律问题为注重应用的学习提供了严格的检验标准:成功不仅需要回顾法律学说,还需要确定相关规则并将其应用于新的事实模式。
因此,我们利用律师协会审查准备来检验将LLM互动从常规聊天重组为结构化情景是否有助于学习应用法律推理。

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Study Design and Measures
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 研究设计和措施

blocks.en:
Design and participants. We conducted a pre-registered, three-arm, parallel-group randomized controlled trial.
A total of 131 students were assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to one of three learning conditions:
(i) vanilla LLM , a conventional request–response assistant,
(ii) LLM-as-Teacher in which the same LLM was prompted to adopt an expert-tutor,
or (iii) AI Cosmos .
All conditions used the same underlying LLM, holding model capability constant while varying the interaction architecture.
Following our preregistered data-integrity criteria, we excluded participants whose learning logs failed to meet minimum-engagement requirements (e.g., insufficient interaction or exceptionally short inputs), leaving an analyzed sample of N = 111 N=111 ( 37 37 per arm).
We observed no statistically significant between-group differences in the measured pre-intervention characteristics, including sex, prior legal training, age, AI literacy, self-efficacy, and pre-test performance (all p ≥ 0.27 p\geq 0.27 ; Table 1 in Appendix A.1 ).

blocks.en:
Procedure and measures. Participants completed four phases:
(1) Pre-test : An AI-literacy inventory, the General Self-Efficacy Scale (GSES, Schwarzer and Jerusalem (1995) ), and a legal-knowledge assessment
covering civil and criminal law. This assessment combined objective single- and multiple-choice items with open-response questions.
(2) Learning : Participants studied matched civil- and criminal-law problems using only their assigned system.
(3) Immediate post-test : A new, difficulty-matched legal assessment with the same composition, followed by the GSES and the NASA-TLX workload index ( Hart and Staveland, 1988 ) .
(4) Delayed post-test ( ≈ 4 \approx\!4 weeks later): A randomly selected subsample ( n = 18 n=18 per condition) completed a new assessment of the same composition to probe retention.
All legal assessments were scored on a 0–100 scale, with objective items weighted at 80 % 80\% and open-response items at 20 % 20\% .
The open responses were scored by three law PhDs whose ratings showed high agreement (Cronbach’s α = 0.95 \alpha=0.95 pre-test, 0.96 0.96 post-test) and were averaged.
The outcome was the learning gain , defined as the post-test minus pre-test change in total score.

Statistical analysis. We report group means and standard deviations for all primary outcomes.

Shapiro–Wilk tests did not reject normality of the gain distributions (all p > 0.05 p>0.05 ), and Levene’s test indicated no evidence of unequal variances ( p = 0.95 p=0.95 ).
The primary between-group inference used ANCOVA on immediate post-test scores, with pre-test score entered as a covariate.
This approach adjusts for chance baseline variation and generally provides greater precision than analysis of raw change scores.
The homogeneity-of-regression-slopes assumption was supported by the condition-by-pre-test interaction test ( p = 0.77 p=0.77 ).
We report the omnibus ANCOVA effect together with η 2 \eta^{2} and model-adjusted contrasts between AI Cosmos and the control conditions.
For complementary unadjusted comparisons of raw learning gains, we report Welch’s t t tests and standardized effect sizes (Cohen’s d d or
bias-corrected Hedges’ g g ) with bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence intervals ( Cohen, 2013 ) .
Subgroup and assessment-component analyses were exploratory and were not adjusted for multiplicity.
All hypothesis tests were two-sided with α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Results

Learning efficacy. All three conditions showed large pre–post gains (paired t t , all p < 10 − 8 p<10^{-8} ; d z = 1.22 d_{z}=1.22 , 1.45 1.45 , and 1.88 1.88 for the vanilla, LLM-as-teacher, and AI Cosmos).
AI Cosmos yielded the largest raw gain ( 22.8 ± 12.1 22.8\pm 12.1 pp), followed by LLM-as-teacher ( 18.5 ± 12.7 18.5\pm 12.7 ) and vanilla LLM ( 15.7 ± 12.9 15.7\pm 12.9 ; Figure 3 b).
The omnibus ANOVA on raw gains approached, but did not reach, statistical significance ( F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 2.94 F(2,108)=2.94 , p = 0.057 p=0.057 , η 2 = 0.052 \eta^{2}=0.052 ).
However, the primary planned contrast was clear:
AI Cosmos outperformed the vanilla LLM by 7.0 7.0 pp (Welch t ⁡ ( 71.8 ) = 2.42 t(71.8)=2.42 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ), a medium effect size ( d = 0.56 d=0.56 , bootstrap 95 % 95\% CI [ 0.10 , 1.05 ] [0.10,1.05] ).
An ANCOVA adjusting for the AI Cosmos group’s slightly lower baseline reproduced this advantage on adjusted post-test means (i.e., post-test scores predicted at the common pre-test mean, i.e., adjusted means 70.2 70.2 vs. 65.8 65.8 ; group effect F ⁡ ( 2,107 ) = 3.00 F(2,107)=3.00 , p = 0.054 p=0.054 , partial η 2 = 0.053 \eta^{2}=0.053 ; AI Cosmos vs. vanilla b = 4.47 b=4.47 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ), with the pre-test serving as a significant covariate ( b = 0.20 b=0.20 , p = 0.001 p=0.001 ).
The advantage of AI Cosmos over the stronger LLM-as-teacher was positive but not statistically significant ( Δ = 4.2 \Delta=4.2 pp, p = 0.146 p=0.146 , d = 0.34 d=0.34 ), while LLM-as-teacher itself did not significantly outperform vanilla LLM ( Δ = 2.8 \Delta=2.8 pp, p = 0.121 p=0.121 adjusted).
With the underlying model held constant, these results indicate a reliable advantage of AI Cosmos over conventional LLM interaction, whereas prompting the same model with a teacher persona alone did not yield a statistically detectable benefit.

Total student input did not differ across conditions (median approximately 7,100 7{,}100 Chinese characters; F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 0.13 F(2,108)=0.13 , p = 0.88 p=0.88 ), nor did session counts ( p = 0.71 p=0.71 ).
However, AI Cosmos elicited approximately 1.7 × 1.7\times as many dialogue turns as either control ( 51.0 ± 21.1 51.0\pm 21.1 vs. 29.6 ± 13.2 29.6\pm 13.2 and 29.2 ± 13.2 29.2\pm 13.2 ; F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 21.8 F(2,108)=21.8 , p = 1.1 × 10 − 8 p=1.1\times 10^{-8} , η 2 = 0.288 \eta^{2}=0.288 ; both pairwise p < 10 − 5 p<10^{-5} ; g = 1.23 g=1.23 [ 0.79 , 1.76 ] [0.79,1.76] ).
Correspondingly, students produced approximately 40 % 40\% fewer characters per turn ( 162 162 vs. 259 259 / 276 276 ; F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 7.66 F(2,108)=7.66 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; AI Cosmos vs. Vanilla LLM p ≈ 0.001 p\approx 0.001 , g = − 0.80 g=-0.80 ).
Thus, despite similar total input volume, AI Cosmos produced a substantially more iterative, turn-rich interaction pattern.
Raw interaction volume itself was only weakly associated with learning gain (rounds: r = 0.16 r=0.16 , p = 0.09 p=0.09 ; characters: r = 0.07 r=0.07 , n.s.), and the association between dialogue turns and gain was further attenuated after controlling for condition ( r = 0.06 r=0.06 , n.s.).
These results suggest that the observed advantage cannot be explained simply by greater interaction volume and is instead consistent with differences in how participation was structured.

Durability. At the four-week follow-up, the descriptive ordering observed immediately after learning was preserved.
Relative to pre-test, the AI Cosmos subsample showed the largest retained gain ( + 18.9 +18.9 pp), followed by LLM-as-Teacher ( + 16.8 +16.8 pp) and Vanilla LLM ( + 14.7 +14.7 pp; Figure 3 d).
The AI Cosmos–Vanilla LLM difference remained positive ( Δ = 4.2 \Delta=4.2 pp, d = 0.34 d=0.34 ) but was smaller than the immediate effect.
With only 18 18 participants per condition, however, the follow-up analysis was underpowered and yielded no significant between-group difference ( F ⁡ ( 2 , 51 ) = 0.48 F(2,51)=0.48 , p = 0.62 p=0.62 ).
Forgetting from the immediate to delayed post-test also did not differ significantly across conditions ( p = 0.43 p=0.43 ).
The follow-up therefore provides directionally consistent but inconclusive evidence regarding retention, and a larger delayed-test sample is needed to determine whether the immediate advantage persists over time.
blocks.zh:
达利布利 在为期四周的后续行动中,保留了学习后立即遵守的描述性命令。
相对于预测试,AI Cosmos子样本显示最大留存收益(+18.9+18.9pp),其次是LLM-as-Teacher(+16.8+16.8pp)和Vanilla LLM(+14.7+14.7pp;图3d).
AI Cosmos – Vanilla LLM的差值仍然为正差(QQ=4.2\Delta=4.2 pp,d=0.34 d=0.34),但小于即时效应.
但是,由于每个条件只有18名参与者,后续分析能力不足,没有产生明显的群体间差异(F QQ(2,51)=0.48 F(2,51)=0.48,p=0.62 p=0.62)。
从立即到推迟的测试,不同条件之间也没有显著差异(p=0.43 p=0.43)。
因此,后续行动就留存问题提供了方向一致但无定论的证据,需要更大的延迟测试样本,以确定是否长期存在直接优势。

blocks.en:
Structured application versus open argumentation. Decomposing the learning gains by item type suggested that the overall advantage was concentrated in the objective, scenario-based items
(Figure 4 ).
Gains on these items were 18.2 18.2 , 21.2 21.2 , and 26.5 26.5 pp for Vanilla LLM, LLM-as-Teacher, and AI Cosmos ( F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 2.89 F(2,108)=2.89 , p = 0.060 p=0.060 , η 2 = 0.051 \eta^{2}=0.051 ).
AI Cosmos exceeded Vanilla LLM by 8.3 8.3 pp ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 1.8 , 14.9 ] [1.8,14.9] , d = 0.56 d=0.56 , p = 0.018 p=0.018 ; ANCOVA-adjusted p = 0.038 p=0.038 ).
By contrast, gains on open-response items were smaller and did not differ across conditions ( 5.6 5.6 – 7.8 7.8 pp; F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 0.23 F(2,108)=0.23 , p = 0.80 p=0.80 ; AI Cosmos vs. Vanilla LLM d = 0.13 d=0.13 , n.s.).
A mixed-design ANOVA showed a strong main effect of item type ( F ⁡ ( 1,108 ) = 55.6 F(1,108)=55.6 , p < 0.001 p<0.001 , η p 2 = 0.34 \eta_{p}^{2}=0.34 ) but no condition-by-item-type interaction ( F ⁡ ( 2,108 ) = 0.95 F(2,108)=0.95 , p = 0.39 p=0.39 ).
Accordingly, the apparent concentration of the AI Cosmos advantage in structured application items should be interpreted descriptively rather than as evidence of moderation by item type.
The present study thus provides stronger evidence for gains in applying legal doctrine to structured fact patterns than for improvements in extended written argumentation.
blocks.zh:
结构化应用与开放式论证. 按项目类型分列学习成果表明,总体优势集中在基于情景的客观项目
(图4).
这些项目的收益分别是:18.2 18.2、21.2 21.2和26.5 pp,分别用于Vanilla LLM、LLM-as-Teacher和AI Cosmos(F = 2.89 F(2 108)=2.89,p = 0.060 p = 0.060,η 2 = 0.051\eta2 = 0.051)。

相比之下,开放式答复项目的增益较小,而且没有不同条件(5.6 5.6 - 7.8 7.8 pp;F = 0.23 F(2 108)=0.23,p=0.80 p=0.80;AI Cosmos vs. Vanilla LLM d = 0.13 d=0.13,ns.)。
混合设计ANOVA显示物品类型的主要效果很强(F  (1,108)=55.6 F(1,108)=55.6,p < 0.001 p < 0.001,p 2 = 0.34\ eta_{p}^{2}=0.34),但没有条件逐项的相互作用(F ⁡(2,108)=0.95 F(2,108)=0.95,p=0.39 p=0.39).

blocks.en:
Robustness across learners. Exploratory subgroup analyses examined whether the AI Cosmos advantage was restricted to particular learner profiles.
Across median splits on prior knowledge and AI literacy, the AI Cosmos–Vanilla LLM effect remained directionally positive, although the small subgroup sizes ( 15 15 – 22 22 participants per condition) produced wide confidence intervals and no multiplicity correction was applied
(Figure 5 ).
These analyses are therefore treated as consistency checks rather than tests of moderation.
A complementary split at the median pre-test score ( 46.7 46.7 ) showed the same descriptive ordering in both prior-knowledge strata.
Among lower-scoring learners, gains were + 28.4 +28.4 , + 26.0 +26.0 , and + 21.8 +21.8 pp across the three conditions, whereas among higher-scoring learners they were + 14.5 +14.5 , + 9.6 +9.6 , and + 10.6 +10.6 pp (Figure 6 ).
Lower-pre-test learners gained more overall ( F ⁡ ( 1,105 ) = 46.8 F(1,105)=46.8 , p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ), but the condition-by-prior-knowledge interaction was not significant ( F ⁡ ( 2,105 ) = 0.55 F(2,105)=0.55 , p = 0.58 p=0.58 ).
Together with the pre-test-adjusted ANCOVA, these results argue against the overall AI Cosmos effect being attributable solely to its slightly lower baseline performance.
blocks.zh:
坚固横跨学人. 探索分组的分析研究了AI宇宙的优势是否仅限于特定的学习者简介.
AI Cosmos-Vanilla LLM效应在以往知识和人工智能知识方面的中位分数中仍然呈方向阳性,尽管小分组的规模(每个条件15个15个-22个参与者)产生了宽广的置信间隔,没有采用多重校正方法
(图5).
因此,这些分析被视为一致性检验,而不是温和检验。
在测试前中位数(46.7 46.7)的辅助分数显示,在先前的知识阶层中,描述顺序相同。
在分数较低的学习者中,收益是+28.4+28.4、+26.0+26.0和+21.8+21.8页,在分数较高的学习者中,收益是21.8+21.8页。 它们是:+14.5+14.5,+9.6+9.6,+10.6+10.6pp(图6)。

连同试验前调整的ANCOVA,这些结果与AI Cosmos效应的总体影响完全归因于其略低的基线性能。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : AI Cosmos shows the largest learning gains across both aptitude strata. Participants were split at the median pre-test score ( 46.7 46.7 ) into (a) lower- and (b) higher-prior-knowledge strata . Translucent points are individual pre/post scores; filled markers are group means ± \pm 95 % 95\% CI. The slope of each connecting line is the mean learning gain (annotated). blocks.en:
Self-efficacy and cognitive load. Self-efficacy gains were descriptively largest for AI Cosmos ( + 5.2 +5.2 vs. + 4.8 +4.8 and + 3.9 +3.9 GSES points; d = 0.35 d=0.35 vs. Vanilla LLM), but the between-group difference was not significant ( F ⁡ ( 2 , 80 ) = 1.02 F(2,80)=1.02 , p = 0.37 p=0.37 ).
Perceived workload also did not differ significantly across conditions (NASA-TLX: 19.4 19.4 , 18.2 18.2 , 17.5 17.5 ; F ⁡ ( 2 , 78 ) = 2.31 F(2,78)=2.31 , p = 0.11 p=0.11 ).
Thus, we found no evidence that the larger learning gains and more iterative interaction observed with AI Cosmos were accompanied by greater perceived workload.

blocks.en: 4.2 Human Study: An Instrumented Workbench for Skill Acquisition in Competitive Programming
blocks.zh: 4.2 人类研究:在竞争性方案拟订中获取技能的仪器工作台

blocks.en:
Whereas the bar-examination study (§ 4.1 ) primarily examined scenario-based social interaction, this study focuses on the operational dimension: the executable workbench.
Competitive programming provides a demanding test of procedural competence, because success requires learners not only to understand an algorithm but also to implement, execute, and debug it as a correct and efficient program.
We thus examine whether integrating an executable coding workbench into the learning interaction improves the translation of conceptual understanding into implementation skill, and whether the effect varies with prior aptitude.
blocks.zh:
律师协会审查研究(第4.1节)主要研究基于情景的社会互动,而这项研究则侧重于业务层面:可执行的工作平台。
竞争性编程对程序能力提供了一个要求很高的测试,因为成功不仅需要学习者理解一个算法,而且需要执行,执行,调试它作为一个正确有效的程序.
因此,我们审查将可执行编码工作板纳入学习互动是否有助于将概念理解转化为执行技能,以及效果是否因先前的能力而异。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Study Design and Measures
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 研究设计和措施

blocks.en:
Design and participants. We conducted a preregistered, three-arm randomized controlled study stratified by two aptitude-defined curriculum tracks.
From the 140 students recruited, 100 completed the diagnostic pre-test, and 54 completed the full multi-session protocol and constituted the analysis sample ( 93 % 93\% male; mean age 18.9 18.9 years; 89 % 89\% first-year undergraduates).
Participants were assigned to one of three learning conditions:
(i) Vanilla LLM , a unconstrained conventional request–response assistant;
(ii) LLM-as-Teacher baseline; and
(iii) AI Cosmos , which used the same underlying model within a configured scenario equipped with an executable coding workbench for implementation, execution, and iterative debugging.
Both LLM-as-Teacher and AI Cosmos conditions followed the same restriction against supplying complete solutions, providing a focused comparison of the additional operational affordances available in AI Cosmos.
The Vanilla LLM condition did not impose this restriction.
All three conditions used the same base model, which was independently verified to be capable of solving the experimental tasks.
The diagnostic pre-test was designed to align training content with prior mastery.
Participants who had not yet mastered search and dynamic programming entered the basic-algorithm track , whereas those who had mastered these topics but not the advanced material entered the data-structure track , which covered segment trees and leftist heaps.
Participants already proficient in both sets of material did not proceed to the training phase.
Within each track, participants were randomized across the three conditions ( n = 19 n=19 AI Cosmos, 18 18 LLM-as-Teacher, and 17 17 Vanilla LLM overall; cell sizes 7 7 – 11 11 ).
Thus, the tracks determined what participants studied, whereas the experimental conditions determined how they studied it. We observed no statistically significant between-condition differences in measured baseline characteristics, including pre-test performance within and across tracks and track composition (all p ≥ 0.20 p\geq 0.20 ; Table 2 in Appendix A.2 ; Figure 7 a).
blocks.zh:
设计和参与者。 我们进行了一个预先注册的,三臂随机控制的学习 分级了两个能力明确的课程轨迹。
在招聘的140名学生中,100人完成了诊断性预测试,54人完成了完整的多会程序,构成分析样本(93%为男性;平均年龄为18.9岁;89%为一年级本科生)。
与会者被分配到三个学习条件中的一个:
Vanilla LLM, 一个不受限制的常规请求-答复助理;
(二) LLM-as-Teacher基线;
(三) AI Cosmos,在配置的情景中使用相同的基本模型,配备可执行编码工作台,用于执行、执行和迭代调试。
LLM-as-Teacher和AI Cosmos在提供完整的解决方案时都遵循同样的限制条件,对AI Cosmos中的额外业务费用提供了重点比较。
Vanilla LLM条件没有施加这一限制。
这三个条件都采用了相同的基模型,经过独立核查,能够解决实验任务.
诊断性预测试旨在使培训内容与事先掌握一致。
尚未掌握搜索和动态编程的参与者进入了基本算法轨道,而掌握这些专题但没有掌握先进材料的参与者则进入了数据结构轨道,该轨道覆盖了部分树木和左侧堆积。
已经精通这两套材料的学员没有进入培训阶段。
在每个赛道内,参与者在三个条件(n = 19 n = 19 AI Cosmos,18 LLM-as-Teacher,17 17 Vanilla LLM总体;细胞大小7 7 – 11 11)之间随机排列.
因此,轨道决定了参与者研究什么,而实验条件则决定了他们如何研究。 我们发现,在衡量的基准特征方面,包括轨道内部和跨轨道的试验前性能和轨道组成方面,在条件之间没有明显的统计差异(所有数据都载于第0.20页,p\geq 0.20;附录A.2表2;图7a)。

blocks.en:
Procedure and measures. Each participant completed two training sessions organized around a fixed three-stage practice cycle:
(1) Learn : participants studied one problem interactively with their assigned system and submitted a solution to the online judge (OJ).
(2) Self-check : they attempted a second problem targeting the same algorithmic concept, with assistance available only when needed. (3) Quiz : they independently solved a third problem that tested the same concept under a different problem framing.
Advancement required a full-score OJ submission on all three problems.
One week later, participants completed a contest-style post-test containing two previously unseen problems that required variants or combinations of the trained algorithms.
The post-test thus assessed generalization of the trained implementation skills to novel problems.
To minimize benchmark contamination and memorization, all problems used in the study were newly authored by two competitive-programming experts with NOI/ACM gold-medal credentials and had no online counterparts.
The base model used in all three conditions was separately verified to be capable of solving each task, ensuring that task difficulty did not exceed the model’s underlying problem-solving capability.
Because conventional OJ scores provide limited diagnostic information about partially correct implementations, the two problem authors also rescored all submitted source code while blind to experimental condition.
They first established a common error codebook covering compilation failures, incomplete algorithmic structures, invariant-maintenance errors, boundary and memory faults, complexity or termination failures, and degeneration to brute-force solutions (Appendix A.3 ).
These error categories were mapped to standardized deductions on a five-level mastery scale (G1–G5), anchored in the completeness and correctness of the target algorithm’s implementation.
The experts independently scored each submission, and their scores were then averaged.
Expert scores were strongly correlated with OJ scores (Pearson r = 0.92 r=0.92 – 0.96 0.96 across assessment phases) but captured partial algorithmic competence that binary test-case outcomes could miss.
At post-test, expert rescoring increased the scores of 33 submissions, decreased none, and produced a mean adjustment of + 10.8 +10.8 points. We report three complementary post-test outcomes:
(i) continuous expert-rescored performance ( 0 0 – 100 100 );
(ii) criterion mastery , defined as grade G4 or higher, corresponding to a substantially complete and correct implementation of the target algorithm; and
(iii) score–mastery dissociation , capturing cases in which a submission earns partial credit without demonstrating criterion-level implementation of the target algorithm.
blocks.zh:
程序和措施。 每个学员完成了围绕固定的三阶段实践周期组织的两次培训班:
(1)学习:参与者用指定系统交互研究了一个问题,并向在线法官(OJ)提交了一份解决方案.
(2) 自查:他们试图针对同一算法概念提出第二个问题,只有在需要时才提供援助。 (3)问:他们独立地解决了第三个问题,在不同的问题框架下测试同一个概念.
要取得进展,就必须就所有三个问题提交全数的OJ报告。
一周后,参与者完成了一场比赛式的测试后测试,包含两个先前未见的问题,需要经过训练的算法的变体或组合.
因此,测试后评估了训练有素的执行技能对新问题的普及。
为了尽量减少基准污染和记忆,研究中使用的所有问题都由两名具有NOI/ACM金医学证书的竞争性编程专家新撰写,没有在线同行。
所有三个条件中使用的基础模型都经过单独核查,能够解决每项任务,确保任务难度不超过模型的基本解决问题的能力。
由于常规的OJ分数对部分正确的执行提供了有限的诊断信息,所以两个问题作者在对实验状态视而不见的同时,也重新记录了所有提交的源代码.
他们首先建立了一个常见的错误代码簿,涵盖编译失败,不完整的算法结构,不常变的维护错误,边界和内存断层,复杂性或终止故障,以及退化到野蛮力解决方案(Appendix A.3 .
这些错误类别被绘制成五级掌握尺度(G1-G5)的标准扣减,以目标算法实施的完整性和正确性为基础。
专家对每份划界案都进行了独立评分,然后平均得分。
专家分数与OJ分数密切相关(Pearson r = 0.92 r = 0.92 – 0.96 0.96 跨评估阶段),但掌握了二进制测试结果可能错失的部分算法能力.
在测试后,专家重新评分提高了33份提交的评分,没有减少,并得出10.8+10.8分的平均值。 我们报告三项补充的测试后结果:
(一) 连续的专家评分业绩(0-100 100);
(二) 标准掌握度,定义为G4级或更高,相当于目标算法基本完整和正确的执行;以及
(三) 得分-主分分离,捕捉提交书在不显示目标算法标准水平实施的情况下获得部分信用的情况。

blocks.en:
Statistical analysis. We report condition means and standard deviations and examine unadjusted between-condition differences using one-way ANOVA, with the Kruskal–Wallis test as a nonparametric robustness check.
The primary between-group inference uses ANCOVA on post-test score, adjusting for pre-test performance and curriculum track.
For complementary unadjusted pairwise comparisons, we report Welch’s t t tests and bias-corrected Hedges’ g g with bootstrap 95 % 95\% confidence intervals.
Given the modest per-condition sample sizes ( n = 17 n=17 – 19 19 ) and the bounded or zero-inflated distributions of several outcomes, we additionally report permutation-based p p -values and Mann–Whitney U U tests where appropriate.
Criterion-mastery proportions are compared using Fisher’s exact test, whereas participant-level mastery counts are compared using the Mann–Whitney U U test.
Score-based results are interpreted jointly with criterion mastery, which captures algorithm-specific implementation competence not fully reflected by OJ performance alone.
Track-stratified and submission-level analyses are exploratory and are not adjusted for multiplicity.
All statistical tests are two-sided with α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Results

Skill acquisition. Post-test scores showed a descriptive advantage for AI Cosmos ( 68.0 ± 32.3 68.0\pm 32.3 ), followed by the vanilla LLM ( 61.5 ± 28.1 61.5\pm 28.1 ) and LLM-as-Teacher ( 49.8 ± 31.7 49.8\pm 31.7 ; Figure 7 b).
The omnibus difference was not statistically significant at this sample size ( F ⁡ ( 2 , 51 ) = 1.65 F(2,51)=1.65 , p = 0.20 p=0.20 , η 2 = 0.061 \eta^{2}=0.061 ; Kruskal–Wallis p = 0.22 p=0.22 ), and the ANCOVA group effect after adjusting for pre-test score and training track showed a similar pattern ( F ⁡ ( 2 , 49 ) = 1.89 F(2,49)=1.89 , p = 0.16 p=0.16 , partial η 2 = 0.072 \eta^{2}=0.072 ).
Despite the limited statistical power, the pairwise estimates reveal a consistent architectural advantage.
AI Cosmos outperformed the LLM-as-Teacher baseline by 18.2 18.2 points, yielding a medium effect size (Welch t ⁡ ( 35.0 ) = 1.73 t(35.0)=1.73 , p = 0.092 p=0.092 ; permutation p = 0.091 p=0.091 ; Mann–Whitney p = 0.096 p=0.096 ; Hedges’ g = 0.56 g=0.56 , 95 % 95\% CI [ − 0.06 , 1.30 ] [-0.06,1.30] ).
In contrast, the LLM-as-Teacher condition produced the lowest numerical performance, scoring 11.7 11.7 points below the vanilla assistant ( g = − 0.38 g=-0.38 ).
Within-condition analyses further show that relative to their respective pre-tests, participants using AI Cosmos and vanilla LLM both improved significantly on trained material (paired t t -tests: p = 0.0004 p=0.0004 and p = 0.0008 p=0.0008 , respectively; d z = 1.00 d_{z}=1.00 ), whereas the LLM-as-Teacher condition showed only a non-significant increase ( p = 0.12 p=0.12 , d z = 0.39 d_{z}=0.39 ).
Together, these results suggest that integrating guidance with an executable environment provides a stronger pathway from conceptual explanation to procedural programming ability than dialogue-based guidance alone.

blocks.en:
Equal scores, unequal mastery. The similar aggregate scores of AI Cosmos and vanilla LLM conceal a more fundamental difference in what learners actually achieved (Figure 8 ).
Both conditions produced successful online-judge submissions at comparable rates ( 82 % 82\% vs. 85 % 85\% ), explaining their similar raw scores.
Yet, automated judging primarily measures whether a program passes test cases, not whether the learner has acquired the intended algorithmic skill.
Among submissions receiving positive OJ credit, AI Cosmos achieved criterion mastery (grade ≥ \geq G4) in 68 % 68\% of cases, compared with 45 % 45\% for vanilla LLM and 32 % 32\% for LLM-as-Teacher (AI Cosmos vs. LLM-as-Teacher, Fisher’s exact p = 0.009 p=0.009 ; vs. vanilla, p = 0.12 p=0.12 ).
Conversely, non-mastery passing solutions, i.e., submissions that obtained test credit without substantially implementing the target algorithm, were less frequent under AI Cosmos (26%) than under vanilla LLM (47%) or LLM-as-Teacher (53%; AI Cosmos vs. LLM-as-Teacher, p = 0.031 p=0.031 ).
The results reveal a central limitation of score-based evaluation in AI-assisted programming: passing tests and acquiring transferable procedural knowledge are not identical outcomes.
While a conventional assistant may help learners produce partially successful solutions, AI Cosmos’s executable workbench encourages learners to construct, test, and repair their own implementations, resulting in a higher proportion of solutions that reflect genuine algorithmic understanding.
Thus, the primary advantage of AI Cosmos is not merely higher task performance, but a closer alignment between measured performance and underlying competence.

blocks.en:
Criterion mastery. Because automated scores can obscure differences in solution quality, we next examined criterion mastery: whether learners produced substantially complete and correct implementations of the target algorithms (grade ≥ \geq G4).
This measure captures a stricter form of procedural competence than passing test cases alone (Figure 9 a).
AI Cosmos learners achieved criterion mastery on an average of 1.11 1.11 out of the two post-test problems, compared with 0.76 0.76 for vanilla LLM and 0.50 0.50 for LLM-as-Teacher.
The difference between AI Cosmos and LLM-as-Teacher was significant (Mann–Whitney p = 0.024 p=0.024 ).
Moreover, 36.8 % 36.8\% of AI Cosmos learners achieved mastery on both problems, compared with 17.6 % 17.6\% for vanilla LLM and 11.1 % 11.1\% for LLM-as-Teacher.
The expert-derived error taxonomy further reveals how this advantage manifested in learners’ code (Figure 9 b).
AI Cosmos produced the highest proportion of flawless implementations ( EOK : 52.6 % 52.6\% vs. 38.2 % 38.2\% for vanilla LLM and 25.0 % 25.0\% for LLM-as-Teacher; Fisher’s exact test, AI Cosmos vs. LLM-as-Teacher, p = 0.019 p=0.019 ), and the lowest proportion of incomplete algorithmic structures ( E02 : 5.3 % 5.3\% vs. 8.8 8.8 – 11.1 % 11.1\% in the control conditions).
The ordinal mastery analysis showed a similar pattern: post-test submissions were concentrated at the two extremes of the scale, corresponding to either incomplete attempts or fully correct implementations.
A proportional-odds model further indicated that AI Cosmos learners had higher odds of achieving a stronger mastery level than LLM-as-Teacher learners (odds ratio = 2.59 =2.59 , 95 % 95\% CI [ 1.10 , 6.07 ] [1.10,6.07] , p = 0.029 p=0.029 ).
Together, these results suggest that AI Cosmos primarily improves the quality of acquired programming skill rather than merely increasing the likelihood of obtaining a passing submission.

此外,36.8%的AI Cosmos的学习者掌握了这两个问题,而香草LLM的学习率为17.6%,LLM-as-Teacher的学习率为11.1%。
专家得出的误差分类法进一步揭示了学习者代码(图9b)如何体现这一优势。
AI Cosmos的无缺陷执行比例最高(EOK:52.6% 52.6\%对38.2% 38.2\%对香草LLM,25.0% 25.0\%对LLM-as-Teacher;Fisher的精确测试,AI Cosmos对LLM-as-Teacher,p=0.019 p=0.019),以及不完全算法结构的比例最低(E02:5.3% 5.3\%对8.8 8.8–11.1\%对控制条件).

blocks.en:
Why the workbench matters: executable practice beyond guidance. The preceding analyses suggest that the advantage of AI Cosmos does not arise from providing more instructional content, but from changing how learners interact with that content via an executable environment (Figure 10 ). First , the benefit of the workbench was largest among learners who required greater external scaffolding.
Decomposing the AI Cosmos advantage over LLM-as-Teacher by curriculum track revealed a substantial difference in the basic-algorithm track: AI Cosmos improved post-test scores by 31.4 31.4 points, corresponding to Hedges’ g = 0.94 g=0.94 for scores and g = 1.16 g=1.16 for criterion mastery (the latter reaching significance, Mann–Whitney p = 0.039 p=0.039 ).
The advantage was smaller in the more advanced data-structure track ( + 10.5 +10.5 points; g = 0.32 g=0.32 for scores and g = 0.58 g=0.58 for mastery).
Although the condition × \times track interaction was not significant ( p = 0.34 p=0.34 ), this pattern is consistent with the interpretation that executable environments provide greater support when learners have not yet developed stable internal models of algorithm execution.
For novice programmers, the ability to construct, execute, and debug within the same environment provides a concrete feedback loop that abstract explanations alone cannot provide. Second , the programming study complements the pattern observed in the bar-examination study.
In the legal domain, where competence is expressed primarily through argumentation, additional dialogue structure produced progressively larger benefits.
Yet, in programming, competence must ultimately be expressed through executable artifacts.
Accordingly, instructional guidance without an integrated environment did not produce the same benefit as a workbench-linked scenario.
Together, the two studies suggest that effective AI learning systems must align interaction structure with the form of the target competence.
Structured dialogue supports domains where reasoning itself is the object of practice, whereas executable workbenches support domains where competence emerges through construction, testing, and revision.
AI Cosmos operationalizes this alignment by coupling guidance with the artifacts through which learners practice.
blocks.zh:
工作台为何重要:可执行做法超出指导范围. 上述分析表明,AI Cosmos的优势并不在于提供更多的教学内容,而在于通过可执行的环境改变学习者与该内容的相互作用(图10)。 首先,在需要更多外部脚手架的学习者中,工作台的好处最大。
用课程轨迹来解析AI Cosmos对LLM-as-Teacher的优势, AI Cosmos将测试后分数提高31.4 31.4分,对应Hedges的g=0.94 g=0.94分,g=1.16 g=1.16分标准掌握(后者达到意义,Mann–Whitney p=0.039 p=0.039).
在更先进的数据结构轨道(+10.5+10.5分;g=0.32 g=0.32分,g=0.58 g=0.58分)中,优势较小.
虽然条件×\times轨道相互作用并不显著(p = 0.34 p = 0.34),但这种模式符合解释,即当学习者尚未开发稳定的算法执行内部模型时,可执行环境提供更大的支持.
对于新程序员来说,在同一环境中构建,执行,调试的能力提供了抽象解释无法提供的具体反馈循环. 第二,方案研究补充了律师资格审查研究中观察到的模式。
在法律领域,主要通过论证表达权限,额外的对话结构产生越来越大的好处。
然而,在编程中,最终必须通过可执行文物来表达能力.
因此,没有综合环境的教学指导不能产生与工作基准相关联的情景相同的效益。
这两项研究共同表明,有效的AI学习系统必须使互动结构与目标能力的形式相一致。
结构化对话支持推理本身是实践对象的领域,而可执行的工作本位则支持通过构建、测试和修订产生能力的领域。
AI Cosmos通过将指导与学习者练习的工艺品相结合来实施这种协调。

blocks.en:
Validity: whether performance reflects learner capability. Finally, we conducted an exploratory construct-validity analysis examining whether observed programming performance remained associated with learners’ prior ability (Figure 11 ).
Within the AI Cosmos condition, pre-test standing was positively correlated with subsequent criterion mastery (Pearson r = 0.59 r=0.59 , p = 0.008 p=0.008 ; Spearman ρ = 0.57 \rho=0.57 ), and this relationship remained stable under leave-one-out resampling ( r ∈ [ 0.53 , 0.65 ] r\in[0.53,0.65] ).
In contrast, the corresponding correlations were near zero in both control conditions (vanilla LLM: r = 0.08 r=0.08 , p = 0.76 p=0.76 ; LLM-as-Teacher: r = − 0.06 r=-0.06 , p = 0.80 p=0.80 ).
The difference between AI Cosmos and LLM-as-Teacher was significant (Fisher’s z z , p = 0.040 p=0.040 ), with a similar but non-significant trend against vanilla LLM ( p = 0.11 p=0.11 ).
This pattern suggests that different interaction architectures may produce different relationships between measured performance and learner capability.
When learners can rely heavily on generated code, final submissions may partially reflect system assistance rather than the learner’s own
implementation ability.
By requiring learners to participate in construction, execution, and debugging, AI Cosmos makes observed performance more closely coupled with the learner’s demonstrated competence.
Thus, the findings highlight an important consideration for AI-assisted learning evaluation: improving performance is insufficient if the resulting measure no longer reflects what learners can independently do.
blocks.zh:
有效性:表现是否反映了学习者的能力. 最后,我们进行了一次探索性构建-有效性分析,审查所观察到的方案拟订业绩是否与学员的先天能力有关(图11)。
在AI Cosmos条件下,测试前的状态与随后的标准掌握有正比关系(Pearson r = 0.59 r = 0.59,p = 0.008 p = 0.008;Spearman ^ = 0.57\rho = 057),这种关系在一次休整下保持稳定(r ∈ [0.53, 0.65] r\ in [0.53, 0.65]).
相比之下,在两种控制条件下对应的关联性都接近于零(vanilla LLM:r = 0.08 r = 0.08,p = 0.76 p = 0.76;LLM-as-Teacher:r = − 0.06 r = - 0.06,p = 0.80 p = 0.80).
AI Cosmos和LLM-as-Teacher的区别很大(Fisher's z z,p = 0.040 p = 0.040),对香草LLM(p = 0.11 p = 0.11)有类似但并不显著的趋势.
这种模式表明,不同的交互架构可能会在测量的性能和学习能力之间产生不同的关系.
当学习者可以大量依赖生成的代码时,最后的提交可能部分反映系统帮助,而不是学习者自己的
执行能力。
AI Cosmos要求学习者参与建筑、执行和调试,使所观察到的性能与学习者表现出的能力更紧密地结合起来。
因此,调查结果突出强调了AI辅助学习评价的一个重要考虑:如果由此产生的措施不再反映学习者可以独立完成的工作,改善业绩是不够的。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
AI-Assisted Learning and Pedagogically Structured Interaction Evidence from mathematics and programming education shows that improved performance with LLM assistance does not necessarily result in better performance on subsequent unassisted assessments ( Bastani et al., 2025a ; Bassner et al., 2025 ) .
Research on LLM tutoring has investigated ways to guide students during problem solving rather than directly supply answers.
Earlier work uses annotated tutoring dialogues ( Macina et al., 2023 ) and explicit pedagogical policies to study and organize multi-turn guidance ( Pal Chowdhury et al., 2024 ; Puech et al., 2025 ) .
More recent methods train pedagogical policies ( Dinucu-Jianu et al., 2025 ) , adapt feedback using learner-state estimates and task verification ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and maintain instructional plans across interactions ( Li et al., 2026b ; David and Ghosh, 2026 ) .
Tutoring benchmarks further assess instructional behavior beyond answer correctness ( Maurya et al., 2025 ; Macina et al., 2025 ) .
These studies demonstrate progress in adaptive instructional support. However, evaluations of tutoring quality or success on guided tasks do not by themselves establish what learners can do independently. An important question is how students’ own actions during assisted problem solving affect their later performance on unfamiliar tasks without assistance.
blocks.zh:
来自数学和编程教育的AI-Assisted Learning和教学结构互动证据表明,在LLM的协助下,业绩的改善不一定导致后续无援助评估的绩效的改善(Bastani等人,2025a;Bassner等人,2025年)。
对LLM辅导的研究研究了在解决问题时指导学生而不是直接提供答案的方法.
先前的工作利用附加说明的辅导对话(Macina等人,2023年)和明确的教学政策来研究和组织多回合指导(Pal Chowdhury等人,2024年;Puech等人,2025年)。
较新的方法培训教学政策(Dinucu-Jianu等人,2025年),利用学习者 -- -- 状态估计和任务核查调整反馈(Wang等人,2025年),并维持跨越相互作用的教学计划(Li等人,2026年b;David和Ghosh,2026年)。
指导基准进一步评估超出答案正确性的教学行为(Maurya等人,2025年;Macina等人,2025年)。
这些研究表明,在适应性教学支助方面取得了进展。 然而,对指导性任务辅导质量或成功率的评价本身并不确定学习者可以独立做些什么。 一个重要问题是,学生自己在协助解决问题过程中的行动如何影响他们以后在没有帮助的情况下从事不熟悉的工作。

blocks.en:
Human–Agent Participation in Interactive Task Environments Agent coordination can support human participation rather than only automate task completion.
Co-STORM allows users to guide discussions among agents and reports higher-quality exploratory outputs than its comparison systems ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
In a course-based multi-agent learning environment, students exhibited distinct patterns of knowledge co-construction and co-regulation, associated with prior knowledge and learning gains ( Hao et al., 2025 ) .
Participation in executable tasks also requires actions that change task state and produce feedback.
CodeAct and SWE-agent improve agent performance through execution feedback and task-specific interfaces ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024b ) , while TutorGym evaluates tutoring agents on intermediate actions in interactive learning systems and identifies substantial errors in their judgments of incorrect steps ( Weitekamp et al., 2025 ) .
Magentic-UI and Collaborative Gym further allow users to participate during agent execution ( Mozannar et al., 2025 ) ; the latter reports better collaborative task outcomes than autonomous execution ( Shao et al., 2026 ) .
These results establish capabilities for conversational participation and shared task execution.
For learning applications, however, task success alone does not establish which reasoning and operations learners performed themselves.
blocks.zh:
人类代理人参与互动任务环境 代理协调可以支持人类参与,而不仅仅是自动完成任务。
共同STORM允许用户指导代理商之间的讨论和报告比其比较系统更高质量的探索性产出(Jiang等人,2024年).
在一个基于课程的多代理学习环境中,学生展现了与以往知识和学习成果相关的知识共同构建和共同调节的独特模式(Hao等人,2025年)。
参与可执行的任务还需要改变任务状态和产生反馈的行动.
代码法和SWE代理通过执行反馈和特定任务接口改善代理性能(Wang等人,2024a); Yang et al., 2024b),而TutorGym则评价互动学习系统中的中间动作的辅导代理,并找出其判断错误步骤的重大错误(Weitekamp et al., 2025).
紫外线与协作 Gym还允许用户在代理执行期间参与(Mozannar等人,2025年);后者报告的合作任务结果比自主执行更好(Shao等人,2026年)。
这些结果建立了对话参与和共同执行任务的能力。
然而,对于学习应用而言,单靠任务成功并不能确定哪些推理和操作学习者自己进行。

blocks.en:
Knowledge Building and Reusable Practice Records Learning activities can produce resources that remain useful after a task is completed.
In knowledge-building environments, students improve shared ideas through successive contributions, while Learning by Design incorporates earlier design attempts into later inquiry ( Scardamalia and Bereiter, 2010 ; Kolodner et al., 2003 ) .
More recent tools make learners’ activity records accessible: Watanabe et al. (2025) combines programming and browsing histories and identifies distinct problem-solving patterns that are not evident from final submissions alone.
Related research on LLM agents shows that experience can also be reused for subsequent execution.
Agent Workflow Memory extracts reusable routines and improves web-task success ( Wang et al., 2024b ) , G-Memory retrieves collaboration histories together with generalized insights ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , and Skill-Pro validates procedural skills for reuse across tasks and agents ( Mi et al., 2026 ) .
These results establish two uses of prior activity: improving an agent’s later actions and helping people examine and revise earlier work ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
The distinction matters for educational systems, where a reusable solution does not necessarily preserve the decisions, feedback, and revisions through which learners developed it.
blocks.zh:
知识建设和可重复使用的做法记录学习活动可以产生任务完成后仍然有用的资源。
在知识建设环境中,学生通过连续贡献来改善共同的想法,而 " 学习设计 " 则将早期的设计尝试纳入以后的调查(Scardamalia和Bereiter,2010年;Kolodner等人,2003年)。
最新的工具使得学习者的活动记录可以访问: 渡边等. (2025) 将编程和浏览历史结合起来,并找出仅从最后提交材料中无法看出的不同解决问题的模式。
关于LLM剂的相关研究表明,经验也可以被重新用于后续执行.
Agent Workflow Memory 提取可重复使用的例行程序并改进网络任务的成功(Wang等人,2024b) ,G-Memory检索协作历史,并附上一般见解(Zhang等人,2026c),Skill-Pro验证跨任务和代理人再利用的程序技能(Mi等人,2026年)。
这些结果确定了以前活动的两种用途:改进代理人的后期行动,帮助人们审查和修改以前的工作(Zhang等人,2026b;Li等人,2026a)。
区别对教育制度很重要,因为可重复使用的解决办法不一定能保留学生通过这种办法作出的决定、反馈和修改。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes AI-assisted learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice.
Through the Scenario–Asset Framework, AI Cosmos enables learners and role-specialized agents to participate in structured learning activities, while preserving the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets across scenarios.
Two preregistered controlled studies in learning legal reasoning and competitive programming demonstrate the potential of structured participation to improve learners’ independent competence.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了AI Cosmos,这是一个用于定位学习的代理基础设施,它围绕两个互补原则组织AI辅助学习:基于情景的参与和累积的实践资产。
通过设想-资产框架,AI Cosmos使学习者和角色专门机构能够参与有条理的学习活动,同时保留实践的过程和结果,作为各种假设的可重复使用的资产。
在学习法律推理和竞争性编程方面进行两项预先登记的受控研究,表明有组织地参与提高学生独立能力的潜力。

blocks.en: A.3 Expert Re-grading Rubric: Mastery Scale and Error Codebook
blocks.zh: A.3 重新定级的专家 鲁布里克: 精密缩放和错误代码簿

blocks.en: To convert the coarse, test-case-based online-judge (OJ) score into a measure of genuine algorithmic competence (§ 4.2 ), two NOI/ACM gold-medalist experts re-graded every submission, blind to arm, using the two-part rubric reproduced here: a five-level mastery scale (G1–G5; Table 3 ) that summarizes how completely and correctly a submission realizes the problem’s target algorithm , and an error codebook (Table 4 ) that records the specific failure mode underlying that grade. Each submission is tagged in the form [code:name] together with a grade. Throughout, the “target algorithm” is the intended solution for the problem at hand (e.g., flood-fill or dynamic programming on the basic-algorithm track; a segment tree or leftist heap on the data-structure track). Two grading conventions are central and explain why the expert grade can diverge from the raw OJ score. First, a submission that merely passes test cases by means of a brute-force or otherwise non-target method is not credited as mastering the target algorithm: it is normally graded G1, regardless of the points it earns. Second, every submission that “looks like the target algorithm but falls short of full marks” was re-run locally and assigned a specific failure code before being graded, so that the grade reflects a diagnosed failure mode rather than the OJ verdict alone. The criterion-mastery threshold used in the main text is grade ≥ \geq G4 (i.e., G4 or G5); the “flawless-implementation” rate ( EOK ) reported there is exactly the G5 rate.
blocks.zh: 将粗糙的、基于测试的在线裁判员(OJ)得分转换成真正的算法能力(第4.2节),两名NOI/ACM金医学专家对每一份呈文重新进行分级,视而不见,使用在此所复制的两段分数:一个五级的掌握度表(G1–G5;表3),总结呈文如何完整和正确地实现问题的目标算法,以及一个记录该分数所依据的具体失败模式的错误编码本(表4). 每一份划界案均在表格[代码:名称]中加一个等级。 在整个过程中,“目标算法”是手头问题的预期解决办法(例如,在基本算法轨道上填洪或动态编程;在数据结构轨道上的一个段树或左侧堆积)。 两项定级惯例是核心,并解释为什么专家级别可以不同于最初的OJ分数。 首先,仅通过野蛮武力或其他非目标方法的测试案例的呈文不会被记为掌握目标算法:它通常被评为G1级,无论它得到的分数如何。 其次,每一份“看起来像目标算法,但没有满分”的呈文都在当地重新运行,并在被分级之前指定了具体的故障代码,因此,该分级反映的是确诊的故障模式,而不是OJ判决。 主文中使用的标准主阈值为\\ geq G4(即G4或G5)级;据报告,“不法执行”率正是G5率。

blocks.en: Table 3 : The five-level mastery scale used by the expert re-graders. Each grade is anchored to how completely and correctly a submission realizes the problem’s target algorithm. The criterion-mastery threshold used in the main text is grade ≥ \geq G4.
blocks.zh: 表3:专家复级人员使用的五级掌握等级表. 每个等级都取决于提交文件如何完整和正确地实现问题的目标算法。 主文中使用的标准主阈值为 \\\ geq G4 级。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Error codebook. Every submission is tagged [code:name] ; the code records the specific failure mode underlying the grade. “Severity” reflects how far the failure is from a correct target-algorithm implementation. Codes E01 – E07 and E00 are mutually informative failure modes; N01 / N02 are annotations rather than errors; sub-variant suffixes (e.g., -S0 / -S1 ) distinguish source-availability and intent sub-cases and are merged into their base code for the aggregate analysis.
blocks.zh: 表4:错误代码簿。 每次提交都标记[代码:名];代码记录了该等级背后的特定故障模式. “严重性”反映了失败与目标逻辑正确执行的距离。 代码E01 – E07和E00是互相信息化的失败模式;N01 / N02是说明而不是错误;次变量后缀(如-S0 / -S1)区分源可用性和意图子大小写,并被合并到其基础代码中进行汇总分析.

blocks.en: The two parts are coupled: the error code localizes what went wrong, and the mastery grade places that failure on a single ordinal scale of target-algorithm competence. Thus an E06 (brute-force) or N02 (non-target) submission is graded G1 however many test cases it passes, an E02 (incomplete skeleton) typically maps to G2–G3, a submission with only minor defects maps to G4, and an EOK submission is G5. The main-text failure-mode analysis (Figure b) reports the rates of the three most diagnostic outcomes on the post-test problems— EOK (correct), E06 (brute-force degeneration), and E02 (incomplete skeleton)—computed over all submissions in each arm.
blocks.zh: 这两个部分是结合的:错误代码将出错的地方定位,而掌握的等级将失败放在目标-算术能力的单一正数尺度上. 因此,一个E06(Brute-force)或N02(非目标)划界案被评为G1级,尽管它通过了许多测试案例,一个E02(不完全骨架)通常会映射到G2-G3,一个只有小缺陷地图的划界案被评为G4级,一个EOK划界案是G5级。 主文本故障模型分析(图b)报告了测试后问题的三个最有诊断性的结果——EOK(正确)、E06(Brute-force degene)和E02(不完整骨架)——的比例,计算了每个臂的所有提交材料。
